text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 decode latency spike detected in streaming-prod (us-west-2). streaming.decode.tail.p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Affected: runtime-decode. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-decode
Emma (oncall): @incident-bot acknowledging. I'm paged. Checking dashboards now. @raj @kyle please standby for triage. Any recent kernel or TRT/FlashAttention rollouts?
raj: we rolled trt8 + flashattn-2.0 into canary yesterday morning (runtime-canary-3). kernel v2.3.1 rolled to prod nodes ~4h ago.
Maria (support): getting customer tickets from AcmeCorp — reports of streaming stalls/timeouts. ~12 affected sessions in last 10m. Error seen: "streaming: decode stall: kv-pagefault"
Emma (oncall): ok rolling hypothesis = kernel/compilepath regression causing KV paging. p95 also up ~350ms. adding @platform-sre for infra metrics
platform-sre: looking at node metrics now — swap 0, but kernel pagefault counts spike and stall counts rising on gpu0. quick snapshot: ```node-42 pagefaults: 8k -> 56k in 10m
runtime-decode tail queues: 120 -> 900
nv_driver_errors: 0```
kyle: flashattn on trt8 can bump memory pressure slightly. pagefaults align with new module 'compilepath-opt' v2.3.1. checking build tags and kernel modules.
raj: confirmed compile flags in recent build: "-O3 -march=native -fno-plt" plus custom-kernel-linker. quick grep of deploy manifests in canary: ```kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -o wide | grep runtime-canary-3```
Emma (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from affected pool (us-west-2 runtime-prod-*), 2) fallback to smaller-kv model variant for streaming, 3) consider kernel rollback. @ops-bot initiate reroute.
ops-bot: Command accepted: initiating route-shift. Removing 4 hosts from pool runtime-prod-usw2-azb. Expected completion ~45s.
deploy-bot: rollback event queued: rolling kernel v2.3.0 back on 4 nodes (initiated by Emma). job id 7892.
kyle: after route-shift p99 dropped to ~420ms, p95 back to ~120ms. some long-lived sessions still stuck; draining and restarting affected pods now.
Maria (support): drafted customer message: "We've identified a transient infrastructure degradation impacting streaming latency in US-WEST-2. We've rerouted traffic and applied mitigations. Engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up." Approve?
Sales-Reachout: I can take AcmeCorp direct channel. Send final note when rollback confirmed.
Emma (oncall): approve. Long-term actions: gate kernel flags in canary, add eviction thresholds to KV cache, run memory-pressure sim. @raj please own postmortem and add to next sprint.
raj: ack. I'll pull perf traces, compilepath build artifacts, and try repro with current compile flags. will revert custom linker if needed.
Emma (oncall): handing off to Maria for night oncall. Maria you own incident state and customer comms. I'll be on hand for 15m during handover. @Maria (support) please ack.
Maria (support): ack. Taken over. Tracking timeline in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/6600001234. Next: monitor p99, confirm drained nodes fully out, verify ticket updates.
deploy-bot: rollback complete: kernel v2.3.0 restored on nodes [runtime-prod-usw2-azb-1..4]. Health checks passing.
platform-sre: post-rollback metrics: pagefaults down to baseline, p99 ~180ms. no nv_driver errors. recommend we keep trt8+flashattn in canary but pin kernel to 2.3.0 until we can reproduce locally.
Emma (oncall): :thumbsup: great work. We'll schedule a postmortem and owner for follow-up fixes. Incident severity and SLA impact to be reviewed. Closing active mitigation — leave channel open for postmortem notes.
